newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Lands' End estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lands' End estimate raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it raised its earnings estimate for Lands' End Inc in fiscal 1998 to $1.70 a share from $1.64 and introduced an estimate for fiscal 1999 of $2.00.
-- Lands' End reported excellent fourth quarter results of $1.15 a share versus $0.80 and fiscal 1997 results of $1.54 versus $0.96 in fiscal 1996, EVEREN said.
-- Margins were significantly higher thanks to better inventory management and somewhat better merchandise sourcing, EVEREN said.
-- Lands' End is an apparel marketer.
-- Its shares were trading off 5/8 Friday at 27-3/4.
